audit.why: Riven owns every stage except Sejuani's level 6 and the late game; that matches the 51.03% over 729 games, which is carried almost entirely by teamfights rather than lane.
Spikes at Riven 3, Riven 6, Sejuani first item and Sejuani late are right; the level-6 spike now names Wind Slash rather than a generic 'second activation'.

audit.whatIsWrong: 1) early tells you not to trade 'into her passive shield'. Riven's passive is Runic Blade — her abilities charge the blade and her basic attacks spend the charges. The shield is Valor (E). 2) Valor is a dash as well as a shield and is never mentioned, even though the page repeatedly warns about her chasing you. 3) whys[1] says 'Riven's second Q dash comes at level 2' — Broken Wings has all three reactivations from rank 1; nothing new unlocks at level 2. 4) Sejuani's resistances are called 'Permafrost resistances' or 'Permafrost armor' in three places; they are Fury of the North's Frost Armor.
audit.why: A shield attributed to the wrong ability, a dash absent from a page about disengage, and a level-2 unlock that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Runic Blade named for what it does, Valor named as the shield-dash on 10 seconds at rank 1, the Broken Wings unlock claim removed, Frost Armor named correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing lines here and no numbers appear anywhere.
audit.why: Ki Burst is her only hard CC at 11 seconds at rank 1, and Valor is 10 — those two numbers define every window you get.

audit.whatIsWrong: The R follow-up is described only as a 'second activation' that executes below half HP.
audit.why: The recast is named Wind Slash and Riot's description calls it a powerful ranged attack usable once; the half-HP execute threshold is not in the data.
audit.corrected: Named Wind Slash and described as her one ranged finisher, without asserting a threshold.

edits.before: At level 1 neither of you has a real combo, but Riven can weave an early Q dash auto to start applying pressure — match the auto and back off rather than trading into her passive shield. At level 2 she gets the full Q chain and can threaten a quick knock-up into auto burst; stand far enough that her Q dashes land on a minion, not you, and refuse the trade until you have W. Level 3 is her danger window: Q-Q-Q into W stun into autos is a real burst package. Stack Frost with both W strikes when she steps up, but do not spend E Permafrost until she has burned all three Q dashes — the moment her mobility is gone, the stun lands clean and you even the trade.
edits.after: At level 1 neither of you has a real combo, but Riven can weave a Broken Wings dash into an auto to start applying pressure — match the auto and back off rather than feeding Runic Blade charges. At level 2 she can already chain all three Broken Wings casts into a knockback; stand far enough that those dashes land on a minion, not you, and refuse the trade until you have W. Level 3 is her danger window: Broken Wings into Ki Burst stun into autos is a real burst package. Stack Frost with both W strikes when she steps up, but do not spend E Permafrost until she has burned all three dashes — the moment her mobility is gone, the stun lands clean and you even the trade.

edits.before: Riven's second Q dash comes at level 2 and she can auto-weave for real burst; you have W but not the full combo yet, so respect the trade.
edits.after: Riven chains all three Broken Wings casts from rank 1 and auto-weaves burst off Runic Blade; you have W but not the full combo, so respect the trade.

edits.before: Sunfire Aegis contact burn plus rising Permafrost resistances mean the extended trades Riven wants to win start ticking against her — she cannot disengage cleanly from a tank that heals nothing but hurts by existing.
edits.after: Sunfire Aegis contact burn plus rising Frost Armor resistances mean the extended trades Riven wants to win start ticking against her — she cannot disengage cleanly from a tank that heals nothing but hurts by existing.

edits.before: Full two-item Sejuani — Permafrost armor stacked, CC chain available — outlasts any Riven burst window; Glacial Prison in a teamfight ends her combo before it lands on a carry.
edits.after: Full two-item Sejuani — Frost Armor stacked, CC chain available — outlasts any Riven burst window; Glacial Prison in a teamfight ends her combo before it lands on a carry.

edits.before: Sunfire Aegis completed: your passive Permafrost resistance stacks plus Sunfire's contact burn mean Riven bleeds HP in every extended trade she thought she was winning.
edits.after: Sunfire Aegis completed: Fury of the North's Frost Armor plus Sunfire's contact burn mean Riven bleeds HP in every extended trade she thought she was winning.

edits.before: Absorb her early burst with Doran's Shield and Second Wind, farm cleanly, and let your passive resistance ramp up each wave
edits.after: Absorb her early burst with Doran's Shield and Second Wind, farm cleanly, and let Frost Armor rebuild between waves

edits.before: Burn your Arctic Assault Q early in a trade so she can chase freely after her combo
edits.after: Bait your Arctic Assault out early so Valor's 10-second dash can chase you down

edits.before: Riven's R Blade of the Exile doubles her burst; never let her proc the second activation after you dip below half HP — disengage with Q the moment R lights up.
edits.after: Riven's R Blade of the Exile extends her reach and arms Wind Slash, one powerful ranged hit she gets once — disengage with Q the moment R lights up rather than after.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are a neutral phase — Riven's Q cooldown is short but your passive resistance climbs every wave she ignores you, so use the time to farm with W and let your Permafrost stack passively. At level 6 she hits a real power spike with Blade of the Exile doubling her burst; the pattern is R activation into Q into W stun into autos into R second activation at low HP. The answer: when you see R light up, pop Arctic Assault Q backward through the wave to break her chase before the second R activation lands. You do not need to kill her at 6 — you need to survive it and keep your R Glacial Prison banked for the river fight your jungler is about to start.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are a neutral phase — Broken Wings cycles fast but Frost Armor rebuilds every wave she ignores you, so farm with W and let it hold. Her two real cooldowns are Ki Burst at 11 seconds and Valor at 10; once both are spent she has no stun and no dash, and that is the only window worth a Permafrost. At level 6 she spikes with Blade of the Exile: R into Broken Wings into Ki Burst into autos, then Wind Slash. The answer is to pop Arctic Assault backward through the wave when R lights up. You do not need to kill her at 6 — survive it, and bank Glacial Prison for the river fight your jungler is about to start.

edits.before: - Riven Ki Burst (Stun): matchup-defining — The stun glues her combo together — bait it before fighting. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your Q dash like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Riven Ki Burst: 11s at rank 1 and the only hard CC in her kit — the stun glues her combo together, so bait it before you fight. - Valor: 10s, her shield and her dash in one button. Both spent means both of your answers work.

notes: 'Her passive shield' was wrong: Riven's passive is Runic Blade (abilities charge the blade, autos spend the charges) and the shield is Valor (E), which is also a dash the page never mentioned despite warning repeatedly about her chase. 'Riven's second Q dash comes at level 2' was a fabricated unlock — Broken Wings has all three reactivations from rank 1. Sejuani's resistances were called 'Permafrost resistances'/'Permafrost armor' in three places; they are Fury of the North's Frost Armor. UNVERIFIED, left un-asserted: the existing claim that Riven's R recast executes 'below half HP'. Riot's data says only that Blade of the Exile grants Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack usable once, so I named Wind Slash and dropped the threshold rather than invent one. wants.foe[2] still says she 'runs you into terrain before using R' — terrain matters for her knockback, not for Wind Slash, but I could not verify the interaction well enough to rewrite it, so I left it alone.
